verdict.rationale: The pricing page publishes a flat pay-as-you-go rate of $0.002 per audio minute and a $20/month plan covering 21,600 core minutes, so an agent can compute the base cost of a job from its audio duration. However, the product offers optional features such as speaker diarization, multichannel parsing, word timestamps, audio-type labeling and edge transcription. The 'core transcription minutes' wording suggests extras may be priced separately, and no add-on prices are shown. Missing for 10: itemized add-on/feature pricing, confirmation of whether options change per-minute cost, machine-readable pricing for agents, independent corroboration.
